turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You know "I play" for things you do now. What about last weekend?
Look: Last weekend I played tennis. The game is finished, so play takes -ed.
Rule: for a finished action, add -ed to most verbs.
Right: They opened the window yesterday. Wrong: They open the window yesterday.
Now you. Write the verb in the past:
Last Sunday we ___ (paint) the door.
